downloadFile-url.label: Address
downloadFile-url.tip: URL of the file to download, supports variables

downloadFile-callback.label: Callback
downloadFile-callback.tip: callback function after request completion, @code represents the return value (error is -1), @response represents the response Blob data, @download function represents the download function (can pass in the file name)

downloadFile-rateCallback.label: Progress Callback
downloadFile-rateCallback.tip: download progress callback function, @event represents the progress event object

downloadFile-isBackground.label: Background Storage
downloadFile-isBackground.tip: whether to download and store the file in the background

downloadFile-isBackground-path.label: File Path
downloadFile-isBackground-path.tip: file path for background download and storage
